//: The site is the repository root, served as plain static files — there is nothing to build. `npm run build` makes the single-file offline copy in dist/, which is a distribution artifact rather than the site, so Vercel is told not to run it.

headers.//: A cache-first service worker plus an over-cached sw.js is the classic way a PWA gets stuck on an old version. Browsers will honour max-age on the worker script for up to 24 hours, so revalidate it every time.
Same reasoning for the shell: app.js looking for a form field that a stale index.html does not have is a blank page, not a graceful degradation.
